release_notes: Maintenance Toolkit 4.1.1 fixes hosting HTTP 403 errors in the secure updater by adding a product-only User-Agent. Signature, catalog, integrity and consent checks remain unchanged. Affected 4.1.0 installations need a manual upgrade to 4.1.1. SYSTEM scheduling, partial seven-language UI and GPO ownership safeguards remain; no automatic restart.
